title: Katsudon Currywurst
description: A twist on the classic German currywurst, this recipe combines the flavors of Japan with the comfort of a hearty German sausage.
instructions: 1. In a large pan, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium-high heat.
2. Slice the currywurst sausage into 1/2-inch thick rounds.
3. Add the sausage to the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until browned.
4. Remove the sausage from the pan and set aside.
5. Add the sliced onion and bell pepper to the pan and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
6. Add the tomato paste and curry powder to the pan and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
7. Add the chicken breast to the pan and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-6 minutes.
8. Stir in the katsudon rice and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until heated through.
9. Add the cooked sausage back to the pan and stir to combine.
10. Serve hot, garnished with Panko breadcrumbs if desired.
